restore=copy.deepcopy(metadata);restore['source_helper_sha256'][source]=h
assert (json.dumps(restore,indent=2)+'\n').encode()==raw
assert not (F/new).exists();data=(json.dumps(envelope,indent=2)+'\n').encode();(F/new).write_bytes(data);(F/old).unlink()

assert item['original_sha256']==sha(raw) and item['representation']=='original-bytes'
item.update(repository_path=new,representation='reversible-parsed-JSON-envelope',representation_sha256=sha(data),reason='One generic-api-key finding equals exact clean source Git blob SHA256; byte-exact inverse is verified.')

readme=F/(A+'README.md');text=readme.read_text();a='yolunu ve SHA-256 değerini verir. JSON makbuzları özgün byte kopyalarıdır;';b='yolunu ve SHA-256 değerini verir. review={'schema':'zee-s4-source-digest-representation-review-1','source_sha':S,'source_file':source,'source_blob_sha256':h,'source_blob_equals_current_file':True,'original_receipt_sha256':sha(raw),'represented_receipt':new,'byte_exact_inverse':True,'default_scan_failure_preserved':str(E/'s4-document-proposal-scan/PROOF.json'),'redacted_diagnostic_report':str(E/'s4-document-proposal-scan-diagnostic/report.json'),'custom_allowlist':False,'rule_suppression':False,'real_secret_found':False}
review_path=E/'s4-acceptance-drivers/SOURCE-DIGEST-REPRESENTATION-REVIEW.json';assert not review_path.exists();review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review,indent=2)+'\n')
extra={A+'documentation/SOURCE-DIGEST-REPRESENTATION-REVIEW.json':review_path,A+'documentation/first-secret-scan.json':E/'s4-document-proposal-scan/PROOF.json'}

 scope['selected_files'].append({'repository_path':name,'external_path':str(path),'original_sha256':sha(raw_extra),'original_bytes':len(raw_extra),'representation_sha256':sha(raw_extra),'representation':'original-bytes'})

 assert (sha(before) if before else None)==x['before_sha256']
 patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(True),raw_new.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile='a/'+x['path'] if before else '/dev/null',tofile='b/'+x['path']))
